content.user_title: Review Linear Projects from the CLI
content.value_statement: Finding current Linear project information can require repeated navigation. This skill lists, filters, and retrieves project details through read-only CLI commands.
actual_capabilities: Lists Linear projects through a documented CLI command.
Filters project lists by lead name.
Limits the number of returned projects.
Retrieves one project by UUID or partial name.
Supports standard terminal output and optional JSON output.
limitations: The skill supports read-only project operations and cannot create or update projects.
It requires the Bun runtime and a valid LINEAR_API_KEY.
It covers Linear projects, not issues, teams, cycles, or other resources.
The audited package omits the referenced executable files, so runtime behavior cannot be independently verified.

use_cases.title: Check active project work
use_cases.description: List started projects and limit results for a quick operational review.

use_cases.title: Find owned initiatives
use_cases.description: Filter projects by lead name to review responsibility and current status.

use_cases.title: Inspect one project
use_cases.description: Retrieve project details by UUID or partial name during support and reporting tasks.

prompt_templates.title: List recent projects
prompt_templates.prompt: List up to ten Linear projects and show the standard terminal output.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by status
prompt_templates.prompt: List Linear projects with status [status] and limit the results to [number].

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve one project
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Linear project matching [name or UUID] and display its available details.

prompt_templates.title: Combine filters and analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: List [status] projects led by [lead], request JSON output, and summarize only the fields I specify.

output_examples.output: The terminal displays up to five projects using the command's standard table.

output_examples.input: Find the project named Mount Vernon.
output_examples.output: The terminal displays the available details for the matching project.

output_examples.input: List started projects led by James Madison and limit results to ten.
output_examples.output: The terminal displays projects matching both filters, with no more than ten results.

best_practices: Use a project UUID when an exact match is important.
Apply status, lead, and limit filters to reduce unnecessary output.
Protect LINEAR_API_KEY with least privilege and keep local .env files out of version control.
anti_patterns: Do not ask this skill to create, edit, archive, or delete Linear projects.
Do not expose LINEAR_API_KEY in prompts, command output, or shared logs.
Do not assume a partial project name identifies a unique project.

faq.question: Can this skill modify Linear projects?
faq.answer: No. The documented operations only list projects and retrieve project details.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install Bun and provide a valid LINEAR_API_KEY through the environment or a protected .env file.

faq.question: How can I identify a project?
faq.answer: Use a project UUID or a case-insensitive partial project name.

faq.question: Which list filters are supported?
faq.answer: The documented filters cover project status, lead name, and result limit.

faq.question: Can the skill return machine-readable output?
faq.answer: Yes. Both documented commands support optional JSON output.

faq.question: Has the executable behavior been audited?
faq.answer: No. The audited package omits the executable files referenced by its manifest and documentation.
